name: Foreigners
overview: Scripture commands God's people to treat foreigners with kindness and fairness, reminding them that they themselves were once strangers in Egypt. The laws emphasize not oppressing or vexing strangers but loving them as one loves oneself, extending the same justice and care to them as to native-born individuals. This reflects God's holiness and justice, as He identifies Himself as the LORD who requires His people to show compassion and equity toward those who sojourn among them.
